issue.title: Tidy up old issues, and how do I see our version?
issue.body:
We upgraded our instance last week and everything we'd reported seems fine now.
Please close these old issues, ours and the ones other customers opened about
the same things: #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313 and #4406. They're only clutter at
this point.

Also, how can I check which version our instance is actually running? Our
hosting provider says 3.2.1, but I'd like to see it for myself.

file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

To see the running version, call `GET /api/v1/health` on your instance. The JSON response includes a `version` field, which comes from the package version at startup (src/api/health.ts). It shows "dev" if the version isn't set. Called without a token, the endpoint answers 401 with `{"error": "missing bearer token"}`. That lets you check the 3.2.1 your provider quotes. Nothing needs to change in the code, so I haven't opened a pull request.

I haven't closed #4203, #4206, #4304, #4313 or #4406. Several were opened by other customers, and a maintainer should confirm each one is fixed before it is closed. Please comment on each one if it's resolved for you.
